steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Internal recruitment fills vacancies from within the business (promotion, transfer): quicker, cheaper, motivating for staff, but limits the talent pool and may cause resentment if not transparent. | Key Fact: External recruitment brings in new people from outside: wider talent pool, fresh ideas, but more expensive and time-consuming (advertising, interviewing) and may demotivate existing staff who wanted the role. | Key Fact: A job description lists the duties and responsibilities of the role; a person specification lists the skills, qualifications, and experience required. Both are essential for fair, effective recruitment. | Key Fact: Selection methods: interviews (most common but subjective), application forms/CVs (screening), assessment centres (observe candidates in tasks),
